Metadata.Time Period: 5/22/2015 - current (in season) plus limited previous measurements

columns.name: Measurement Timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when the measurements were taken.

columns.name: Wet Bulb Temperature
columns.description: Wet bulb temperature in Celsius degrees.

columns.name: Rain Intensity
columns.description: Rain intensity in mm per hour.

columns.name: Interval Rain
columns.description: Rain since the last hourly measurement, in mm.

columns.name: Total Rain
columns.description: Total rain since midnight in mm.

columns.name: Precipitation Type
columns.description:
0   = No precipitation 
60 = Liquid precipitation, e.g. rain 
     - Ice, hail and sleet are transmitted as rain (60).
70 = Solid precipitation, e.g. snow 
40 = unspecified precipitation

columns.name: Wind Speed
columns.description: Wind speed in meters per second at the time the record was reported.

columns.name: Maximum Wind Speed
columns.description: Maximum wind speed in the two-minute period immediately preceding the time the record was reported.

columns.name: Solar Radiation
columns.description: Solar radiation in watts per square meter.

columns.name: Heading
columns.description: The current heading of the wind-measurement unit.  The ideal value to get the most accurate measurements is true north (0 degrees) and the unit is manually adjusted, as necessary, to keep it close to this heading

columns.name: Battery Life
columns.description: Battery voltage, an indicator of remaining battery life used by the Chicago Park District to know when batteries should be replaced.

columns.name: Measurement Timestamp Label
columns.description: The Last Updated value in text format, suitable for use in the Visualize function.

columns.name: Measurement ID
columns.description: A unique record ID made up of the Station Name and Measurement Timestamp.
